subject: Re: Menger-RL kickoff — status: replay throughput is the bottleneck
body:
Status before the soak:

- Actor fleet: 1,000 workers stable since 04-28; we've burst-tested to 2,400. Milan's autoscaler recovers from batch-pool preemptions cleanly.
- Learner bridge: Vera has the learner training on our stack; end-to-end on the toy env converges to reference in 6.5h.

Bottleneck: replay ingest. At 3,000 simulated actors, the learner-side replay buffer saturates at ~78% of the sample throughput we need to keep 512 chips fed — the actors produce fast enough on CPU (as the framework promised), but our storage-layer hop adds latency the original in-memory design didn't have. Vera's fix is sharding the replay across 8 ingest nodes; prototype shows 1.35x, which clears the bar with margin.

Risk: the sharded ingest lands ~06-15, two days before soak-readiness. If it slips, options are (a) soak at 384 chips, or (b) accept learner idle time. Will flag by 06-12.

Leilani
